attempted_claim: Let theta=(sqrt(5)-1)/2 and lam*=exp(2*pi*i*theta)*exp(-exp(2*pi*i*theta)), so E4(z)=lam**exp(z) has fixed point z0=exp(2*pi*i*theta) of multiplier exp(2*pi*i*theta) and a Siegel disk, with bounded recurrent postsingular set. Let d=(d_n)_{n>=1} over {0,1} be the Sturmian address d_n=floor((n+1)*theta)-floor(n*theta), which is bounded, aperiodic and of minimal factor complexity. Let g_d be its Schleicher-Zimmer dynamic ray. Decide with proof which holds: (i) g_d lands at a finite point and identify whether it is on the Siegel-disk boundary, a repelling point, or an escaping endpoint; or (ii) g_d does not land and accumulates on a nondegenerate continuum. A complete answer proves exactly one of (i),(ii) for this fixed Siegel map and address.
decisive_failure: No proof of either landing or non-landing alternative was obtained; numerical pullback experiments degenerate and periodic-approximant tests are logically irrelevant to the Sturmian ray. The session confirms only setup facts (parameter identity, finite postsingular bound, Sturmian combinatorics, known-theorem ray existence) and documents the precise blocking obstacle, which future work on aperiodic exponential ray landing could build on.
